Composite Decking
collections.description:
In Downpatrick and County Down, B&C Mckeown is a prominent supplier for high-quality composite decking materials, including popular shades like teak, grey, and dark grey. Their composite decking is designed to endure Northern Ireland's climate, providing resistance against moisture, UV rays, and general wear while needing minimal maintenance. Composite decking is also eco-friendly, crafted from recycled materials, and remains slip-resistant, making it ideal for families.

B&C Mckeown products come in various sizes, such as the 3.6m x 140mm boards, and they invite customers to visit their showroom in Downpatrick for hands-on assistance and design advice. Timber Ireland is another solid option for composite decking in Northern Ireland, offering a similar range with a focus on sustainable materials and durability, with easy maintenance routines for lasting appeal.

For more information or to request a quote, you can reach out to our team directly in Downpatrick.

collections.title: Composite Sheds and Garden Rooms
collections.description:
Composite Garden Rooms & Sheds – Built to Last

At B&C McKeown, we supply high-quality composite garden rooms and sheds designed for modern outdoor living. Combining the natural look of timber with the strength and low-maintenance benefits of composite materials, our garden buildings are the perfect long-term solution for storage, work, or relaxation.

Why Choose Composite?

Composite construction offers superior durability compared to traditional timber sheds. Our buildings are:

  • Weather-resistant – Built to withstand Ireland’s changing climate

  • Low maintenance – No regular painting, staining, or treating required

  • Rot and insect resistant – Designed for long-lasting performance

  • Modern finish – Clean lines with a contemporary look

  • Strong and secure – Engineered for stability and reliability

Versatile Outdoor Spaces

Whether you need extra storage, a home office, hobby space, garden retreat, or workshop, our composite garden rooms and sheds provide a practical and stylish solution. Each unit is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring durability without compromising on appearance.

Built for Irish Gardens

Designed to perform in wet and windy conditions, our composite buildings offer year-round protection for your belongings. With a range of sizes and finishes available, you can choose a structure that perfectly suits your garden and lifestyle.

collections.title: Composite Wall Cladding
collections.description:
Composite Wall Cladding – Durable, Modern & Low Maintenance

Upgrade your exterior or interior space with premium composite wall cladding from B&C McKeown. Designed to deliver the natural appearance of timber without the upkeep, our composite cladding boards offer a long-lasting, weather-resistant solution for homes, garden rooms, sheds, and commercial projects.

Why Choose Composite Wall Cladding?

Our composite cladding is engineered for strength, style, and performance:

  • Low maintenance – No painting, staining, or sealing required

  • Weather resistant – Built to handle Ireland’s changing climate

  • Fade & rot resistant – Long-lasting colour and durability

  • Eco-friendly materials – Manufactured using recycled components

  • Modern finish – Clean, contemporary appearance

Perfect for Multiple Applications

Composite wall cladding is ideal for:

  • Home exterior upgrades

  • Garden rooms and sheds

  • Feature walls

  • Commercial façades

  • Privacy screening

Whether you’re renovating or building new, composite cladding from B&C McKeown provides a sleek, professional finish that stands the test of time.

Built for Irish Conditions

Designed to withstand moisture, wind, and temperature changes, our composite boards offer reliable performance year-round. With a range of colours and profiles available, you can achieve the exact look you want while benefiting from minimal upkeep.

collections.title: Granite Steps, Kerbs etc
collections.description:
B&C Mckeown specializes in a range of high-quality granite products for construction and landscaping purposes. These products likely serve both functional and aesthetic purposes in outdoor and architectural projects. Here's a more detailed overview of the types of products you supply:

1. Granite Steps

  • Description: Durable and aesthetically pleasing, granite steps are perfect for creating elegant and long-lasting pathways or entries. Granite’s natural strength and beauty make it a great choice for both residential and commercial properties.
  • Uses: Outdoor stairways, entrances, gardens, and public spaces.

2. Granite Kerbs

  • Description: Granite kerbs are used to define boundaries along roads, driveways, or walkways. Their durability makes them resistant to wear and tear, ensuring a long lifespan.
  • Uses: Roadways, pedestrian areas, garden edges, or driveways.

3. Granite Paving

  • Description: Granite paving stones offer a luxurious and weather-resistant option for patios, walkways, and driveways. They provide a high-end look while being durable enough to handle high traffic.
  • Uses: Patios, footpaths, and driveway paving.

4. Granite Step Corners

  • Description: These are corner pieces designed to finish off granite steps with precision and elegance. They are used to give a clean and polished look to step installations.
  • Uses: Step installations, garden steps, staircases.

5. Granite Gate Posts

  • Description: Granite gate posts are sturdy and stylish elements used to frame entranceways. Their strength makes them perfect for holding gates securely in place, while their natural look enhances the overall aesthetic of an entryway.
  • Uses: Driveway entrances, estate gates, garden entrances.

collections.title: Security Fencing V Mesh Kits
collections.description:
V Mesh Fencing & Gates – Strong, Secure & Professional Finish

At B&C McKeown, we supply high-quality V Mesh fencing and gates designed for strength, durability, and long-term security. Ideal for residential, commercial, agricultural, and industrial applications, V Mesh systems provide a clean, modern appearance while delivering reliable perimeter protection.

Why Choose V Mesh Fencing?

V Mesh fencing (also known as 3D panel fencing) features reinforced V-shaped bends for added rigidity and strength. It offers:

  • High security and durability – Strong welded steel panels

  • Galvanised & powder-coated finish – Protection against rust and corrosion

  • Low maintenance – Long-lasting performance with minimal upkeep

  • Modern, professional look – Suitable for a wide range of properties

  • Clear visibility – Secure without blocking views

V Mesh Gates to Match

Complete your fencing system with matching V Mesh gates for a seamless and secure finish. Our gates are built to the same high standards, ensuring strength, stability, and smooth operation.

Ideal for Multiple Applications

  • Schools and playgrounds

  • Commercial premises

  • Housing developments

  • Sports facilities

  • Agricultural land

Built to withstand Ireland’s changing weather conditions, our V Mesh fencing and gates provide year-round security and peace of mind.
